title: Mission generated review entry and publication consistency
detail: Generated review entry is at generated/README.md and is included in the published and verified output inventory. Resolve workspace-contained file paths from workspace root and emit links relative to the README. Preserve canonical URNs for Specs and validation evidence. Render outside-workspace artifact paths as unavailable without absolute links. Verify complete artifact reachability, concise promise/delivery/verification orientation, explicit unknowns, empty external status, byte-exact inventories, and distinct changed/missing/extra/dangling/destination-invalid failures. Do not infer acceptance of historical review rows.
